summary: Residential kerb with detached homes within 4-10 m along its whole length.
reasons: Apartments 11 m away at far end
Houses either side of the road

best_section.where: South kerb of Cunningham Street, between the two mid-block houses

drivers.seclusion: Houses at 6 m, 5 m, 9 m and 4 m flank every part of the stretch; more homes opposite at 13-23 m.
drivers.access_and_room: Cars park along the kerb here so a van could pull in, but it sits against gardens.
drivers.traffic: Quiet residential street with a junction at one end.
drivers.convention: Kerb parking is normal, but residents are directly adjacent and would notice.

flags: Dwellings within 10 m of every part of the stretch
Weekday 7am-6pm no-parking signs; overnight not covered
Rail line close to the north-west, some noise
sun_shade: Mixed: tree canopy over parts of the south side, open from the north.
